taxonomy.action_intent_changed: The immediate material speech act or operational intent differs from the historical communication.
taxonomy.excess_clarification: A candidate avoidable preliminary clarification is added; not a finding that asking is unsafe or unreasonable.
taxonomy.excess_escalation: Supervisory escalation is proposed for a routing/representation gap without an explicit manual-review demand; candidate avoidable burden.
taxonomy.missing_operational_step: The observed historical operational communication/step is not proposed; not proof it should have been.
taxonomy.actor_or_role_difference: The target role/recipient differs, including unknown-recipient/internal query instead of external communication.
taxonomy.scope_or_condition_difference: Requested scope, permissions, coverage or conditions differ materially.
taxonomy.timing_or_ordering: The next-step ordering differs, including waiting versus reminder or clarification before troubleshooting.
taxonomy.extra_actions: Additional or duplicated proposals beyond the primary historical communication; may be benign.
taxonomy.unobservable_target_specifics: Material historical topic, details, prior actions or recipient specifics are unavailable before cutoff.
taxonomy.insufficient_prefix: Essential incident/purpose/context for the historical act is absent, not merely unnamed contact information.
taxonomy.ontology_or_identity_fragmentation: Missing/split request or party representation contributes to blocking, abstention or duplicated proposals.
taxonomy.target_annotation_ambiguity: Historical communication is composite/terse/mixed-speaker and its material intent is only partly assessable.
taxonomy.judge_inconsistency: Provisional judge labels vary despite identical evidence availability or materially equivalent predictions; review flag, not a corrected score.
taxonomy.role_resolution_overblocking: A proposal is deferred to identify an already-known contextual landlord/tenant. This is an unnecessary identity blocker under property-contextual-parties-v1, not legitimate missing-person ambiguity.

A missing personal name, contact string or extracted entity ID does not alone justify blocking a proposal. No actual identity, authority grant, provider identity, occupancy fact or contact delivery is invented.
role_context_assumption.interpretation: Old-interface reasonable_alternative labels mean defensible conditional proposal under supplied packet/schema, not recommendation or adequacy under the newly explicit role-known contract.
